    The
    Age of Attraction Season 1 reunion premieres on April 1, 2026, at 7 p.m. ET (4 p.m. PT), hosted by Nick Viall and Natalie Joy on The Viall Files YouTube channel rather than Netflix. The special features updates on couples' statuses, including confirmation that Vanessa and Logan remain engaged. 
    Key Reunion Highlights & Updates: 
    • Where to Watch: The reunion is exclusively on The Viall Files YouTube and podcast platforms.
    • Couples Update: Libby and Andrew are working through long-distance, while Jorge and Vanelle (who had a 33-year gap) address their breakup and potential reconciliation.
    • Missing Cast: Pfeifer did not appear at the reunion, reportedly due to a trip to Japan, but teased more details about her experience with production.
    • Reunion Focus: The special focuses on which of the four committed couples stayed together after leaving the "Promise Room". 
    Other Cast Updates: 
    • Only Libby and Andrew and Vanessa and Logan reportedly remained together after filming ended.
    • Pfeifer and Derrick confirmed they split. 
    The reunion addresses the drama surrounding the show's experiment with age-gap relationships and features intense discussions on life after the show.
